groups.title: Mouse, keyboard, and scroll activity did not renew the session
groups.reason: Continuous mouse movement keeps restarting the five-second timer. Keyboard and scroll actions have no session-renewal connection.
groups.user_impact: The session did not renew during these tests. Later sign-out, interrupted work, and lost work were not observed.
groups.next_action: Keep these cases in the backlog. Repeat them when the agreed activity behavior is implemented.

groups.title: Signing out did not stop the session from being renewed
groups.reason: The server reported successful sign-out but did not invalidate the saved credential used to renew the session.
groups.user_impact: The same valid credential obtained new access after sign-out. Production exposure has not been verified.
groups.next_action: Fix sign-out so the saved credential cannot renew access. Otherwise, prove this release cannot reach the failing path.

groups.title: The loading indicator disappeared before all work finished
groups.reason: One request failed while another was waiting. Error handling removed the loading indication for both requests.
groups.user_impact: The screen appeared ready while work remained pending. No session interruption, repeated submission, or data loss was demonstrated.
groups.next_action: Keep the visual defect in the backlog. Raise its priority if it causes a blocked action or incorrect saved data.

groups.title: A request with two different renewal credentials was accepted
groups.reason: The server used the first credential instead of rejecting the conflicting values. The rejection rule still needs review.
groups.user_impact: The test received access for the first identity. It did not demonstrate access to another user’s account.
groups.next_action: Agree how conflicting credentials must be handled. Then test the complete request through the real server entry point.

groups.title: A request to another website included the portal sign-in credential
groups.reason: The shared request code added the portal credential to a request addressed to an external test website.
groups.user_impact: The test stopped the request before delivery. No external website received the credential.
groups.next_action: Find whether supported application code makes such requests. Check that external destinations never receive portal credentials.

groups.title: A special request setting skipped the sign-in check
groups.reason: A configured request header let the test service continue without a valid sign-in credential.
groups.user_impact: The test reached a protected test function. Access to real business data was not demonstrated.
groups.next_action: Check whether public requests can set this header. Verify that real services reject attempts to bypass sign-in.

groups.title: Combined scenarios did not check real business saves
groups.reason: The tests checked browser and session behavior. No real business service or saved-transaction record was available.
groups.user_impact: The tests did not prove whether unauthorized or duplicate saves are prevented. They did not demonstrate a harmful save.
groups.next_action: Repeat these scenarios with a real business action. Check permissions and server records for each completed save.

groups.title: The cleanup comparison used different page states
groups.reason: Notifications and other page elements differed before and after the test. Their event-handler counts could not be compared fairly.
groups.user_impact: No memory leak, repeated action, forced sign-out, or unusable screen was proved.
groups.next_action: Repeat the comparison with matching page contents. Check that unused event handlers and timers are removed.

groups.title: The browser renewed access, but real server access was not checked
groups.reason: The browser accepted the test credential. The replacement test service did not perform the real server’s security checks.
groups.user_impact: The result does not prove that users can open protected business services after renewal.
groups.next_action: Repeat each case with valid credentials from the real sign-in service. Confirm access as the correct user.

groups.title: Real browser suspension and private-window behavior remain unchecked
